🇨🇭 Swiss trapped-ion startup raises $25.5M seed

@ZuriQ, an @ETH Zurich spinout, has closed a $25.5M seed round, one of the largest quantum seed rounds to come out of Switzerland. The team is building trapped-ion quantum processors, betting on ion transport in two dimensions to scale qubit counts.

Why it matters:
⚛️ Trapped ions remain the highest-fidelity qubit platform today
💰 A $25.5M seed signals conviction, not experimentation
🇨🇭 @ETH Zurich keeps producing globally competitive quantum teams

Quantum hardware is capital-hungry, and Switzerland is now writing cheques at the right size.

https://sifted.eu/articles/eth-spinout-zuriq-seed-round

🇨🇭 Swiss biotech raises CHF 2.4M for gene editing

@Immitra Bio has raised CHF 2.4 million to advance its in-vivo gene editing platform, according to @Venturelab Swiss. Rather than editing cells outside the body, the approach targets them directly inside it, removing the cost and complexity of ex-vivo manufacturing.

Why it matters:
🧬 In-vivo editing could cut cell therapy costs dramatically
🔬 Early capital buys preclinical proof, the real value inflection
🇨🇭 Swiss life sciences depth extends well past big pharma

Small rounds in Swiss biotech often buy more science per franc than elsewhere.

https://www.venturelab.swiss/Immitra-Bio-raises-CHF-24-million-to-advance-invivo-gene-editing-platform

🇨🇭 Swiss space firm raises $70M to build satellites

@SWISSto12, based in Renens, has raised USD 70 million to scale its satellite business as multi-orbit demand grows, reports @Greater Geneva Bern area. The company's 3D-printed radio frequency payloads and small geostationary platforms have already won institutional and commercial telecom customers.

Why it matters:
🛰️ Multi-orbit demand is pulling in new satellite suppliers
🖨️ 3D-printed RF hardware compresses cost and lead times
🇨🇭 Switzerland now hosts a full satellite prime, not just parts

Precision manufacturing turns out to be the hardest moat to copy in space.

https://ggba.swiss/en/swissto12-raises-usd-70-million-to-meet-growing-multi-orbit-satellite-demand/

🇨🇭 Switzerland becomes the metaphor for neutral AI compute

@SkyPilot, founded by a @Databricks cofounder, has raised $20M to become what @Fortune calls the Switzerland of AI compute: a neutral layer routing training and inference workloads across clouds and GPU providers.

Why it matters:
☁️ Multi-cloud AI workloads need a vendor-neutral scheduler
💸 GPU price arbitrage is now a real infrastructure line item
🇨🇭 Swiss neutrality has become global shorthand for trusted infrastructure

When an AI company borrows Switzerland's name to signal trust, the brand is doing serious work.

https://fortune.com/2026/07/21/skypilot-from-databricks-cofounder-raises-20m-to-be-the-switzerland-of-ai-compute/

🇨🇭 Swiss software prices designs before they are locked

@valuemize, Zurich-based, has closed a seven-figure pre-seed round backed by a consortium of VC offices and angel investors. Its software shows manufacturers what a design decision will cost before the design is frozen, when roughly all of a product's cost is still changeable.

Why it matters:
⚙️ Most product cost is fixed at the design stage
📉 Engineering and procurement rarely share one cost view
🇨🇭 Swiss industrial know-how translating into software leverage

Selling to manufacturers is slow, but the ones who crack it rarely get displaced.

https://www.startupticker.ch/en/news/valuemize-raises-seven-figure-pre-seed-for-product-cost-software

🇨🇭 Swiss preventive health raises $10M for Europe push

@Ahead Health, a Swiss preventive health startup, has raised $10M to launch in Germany and the Netherlands, reports @Tech Funding News. The company combines diagnostics with longitudinal tracking, moving healthcare spend from treatment towards early detection.

Why it matters:
🩺 Preventive diagnostics shift cost away from late-stage treatment
🌍 Germany and the Netherlands are dense, insurance-ready markets
🇨🇭 Swiss health quality standards travel well across borders

Health services scale by geography, and Switzerland is a demanding first market to graduate from.

https://techfundingnews.com/ahead-health-10m-funding-preventive-care-germany-netherlands/

🇨🇭 Swiss scale-up adds $19M for US expansion

@Hilo has closed a Series B extension of $19 million, taking total funding past $119 million. New backing came from @Dell Family Office, the investment office of Michael Dell, alongside existing investors, as the company enters the United States market.

Why it matters:
💵 $119M raised to date puts Hilo in scale-up territory
🇺🇸 US entry is the real test of commercial traction
🇨🇭 Swiss health tech attracting top-tier American capital

Another sign that Swiss deeptech scales quietly, then all at once.

https://www.startupticker.ch/en/news/hilo-closes-series-b-extension-round-to-fuel-us-expansion
